items.text: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei authorized the government to negotiate with the US; Tehran says it has compressed a seven-step ceasefire plan into two days and demands the reopening of Hormuz and the lifting of the blockade and sanctions. Trump says talks are "going well" but keeps a post-election strike option on the table; this is the main risk for oil and inflation expectations.
items.title: Iran moves closer to the negotiating table

items.text: The entire House and 35 Senate seats are up on Tuesday; final polls show Democrats ahead in both chambers. The outcome could move markets through the tax and spending agenda and Treasury yields.
items.title: US midterms tomorrow

items.text: Marvell announced it will buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal worth about $115 billion; both shares fell 12–19%. Oracle's $10 billion stock and bond sale and Nvidia's 1.3% decline added to worries about the cost of AI investment.
items.title: Tech sell-off

items.text: The ISM manufacturing index rose to 55.5 in October (September: 54.5), above expectations, while September construction spending fell. A strong PMI could narrow the Fed's room to cut.
items.title: US manufacturing strong

items.text: Last week's roughly $6.3 billion Binance hack has gone on record as the largest crypto theft ever; Bitcoin is trading in a tight range around $78,000.
items.title: Binance heist weighs on crypto
